app.title: San Joaquin Valley Energy Assistance Navigator
app.intro1: Kern and Tulare counties have some of the highest energy rates in the United States. California offers subsidy programs like <1>CARE</1> and <3>FERA</3> to help reduce your monthly bills.
app.intro2: Take the survey to see if you qualify for a discount.
